source.title: Unique Homes | Villa KD45 Residence
source.description:
What if a house didn’t need a front or a back door?
Located in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, this 11,840 sq. ft. villa reimagines green architecture by blending its structure directly into the landscape.

With stepped pathways leading to a fully usable garden roof, preserved mature trees, and natural evaporative cooling pools, it effortlessly solves hot summer climate challenges while creating a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor living.

Proof that modern construction can thrive in complete harmony with nature.

Stay tuned for more inspiring homes!

#uniquehomes #fyp #construction #homeconstruction #explorepage architecture
